model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: v2 common definitions replace v1 common and exact listed module pointers only after Owner adoption. Original embedded behavior rows are historical trace, not competing runtime protocol. Context means WorkflowContext, operation_id means TransitionKey.operation_id at every material call. No in-place update to original Approved artifacts.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.

material_api.import: import(WorkflowContext,TrustedSourceSelection,ImportMetadata,TransitionKey)->ImportedPinnedManifest; native source bytes verified before durable immutable import; no UI path authority
material_api.register_roots: register_roots(TrustedProviderCapability,RootKind)->RootRegistration; internal trusted composition only; no UI registration/callback
material_api.publish_roots: publish_roots(RootRegistration,expected_epoch:u64,RootManifest,TransitionKey)->RootObservationReceipt; owner provider attests current fenced manifest; stale epoch => StaleRoots, unknown => Unknown not empty

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {WorkflowContext,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; same immutable workflow across pin/transfer; no transition operation_id in context.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer receipt lookup with issuer/kind/WorkflowContext/target/evidence validation per proof_registry_record; no trusted DTO body. Missing runtime-only issuer record => UnverifiedOutcome.
proof_types.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
source_reservation.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

recovery_readiness.LocalIntegrityReady: Native coherent recovery index+payload+ALL material copies and hashes/schema verified; independent from original catalog availability.
recovery_readiness.PublicationAcknowledged: Original M05 root transfer receipt and original captured S1 Published/ACK verified.
recovery_readiness.restore: LocalIntegrityReady permits explicit restore to authorized destination even SourceRetentionDeferred. wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. Exact bytes document fixtures required before RED.
replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
proof_registry_record.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.

store_read_contract.grant: Crate-private trusted constructor in M05 application composition: immutable store_identity,pin_id,workflow_id,asset_id,digest,size,pin_catalog_generation; issued only after verified Held or Transferred pin membership. Released pin denied. Not deserializable from UI.

store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

request_digest.algorithm: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 of ENTIRE validated request value, including body recursively. No field projection, ignored fields, defaults or post-hash enrichment. Authentication resolves every opaque handle before frozen body assembly. Server resolved identity/content/evidence fields shown in schema are mandatory.
canonicalization: Reject duplicates before object construction; unknown/missing/null outside declared union reject before replay lookup and IO.
Object names sorted by UTF8 bytes. All scalar text valid Unicode scalar values; no normalization.

Strings: quote and backslash escaped, backspace/tab/newline/formfeed/carriage-return as \b/\t/\n/\f/\r; remaining U+0000..001F as lowercase \u00xx; other scalars literal UTF8; no slash escaping/BOM/whitespace.
All integers U64Decimal strings checked in range. No numeric JSON tokens in transition hash schema.
Arrays preserve admitted order, including resolve requests, entries, aliases, roots, evidence and assets. Order changes conflict; do not sort/deduplicate after hashing.

Same key and valid changed body => ReplayConflict before IO; exact same bytes replay retained receipt. Invalid body => InvalidRequest before key lookup. SHA collision resistance assumed, not proved by vectors.

request_digest.generated_outputs: Pin id created by pin/import is OUTPUT, never caller input. Existing pin_id mandatory for transfer/release. Selection handles freeze full native identity/raw digest/metadata before hash; bundle entries include all admitted metadata and alias mapping.
request_digest.read_only_calls: validate_pin/read_pinned_version/register_roots do not use transition receipt key; authorization and bounds still apply. Provider registration lifecycle unchanged.

lifecycle.event: same authorized request, binding current, identical body
lifecycle.result: Retained exact outcome; replayed=true; do not reapply, downgrade newer UI projection or revalidate new revision in place of captured revision.
ReplayConflict before any dependency IO; no new ordinal to evade conflict.

lifecycle.event: old binding closed, writer transferred or window instance replaced
lifecycle.result: Validate caller/instance/binding first: UnauthorizedCaller or MissingBinding or StaleOwner; old runtime result is not disclosed to new authority. No resubmit on fresh binding.
Owner finishes already admitted operation under captured authority only; keep evidence/Held. No delivery to stale window. New binding cannot claim same runtime request.

lifecycle.event: process restart or runtime record missing
lifecycle.result: UnverifiedOutcome if admitted request cannot be authenticated in current runtime; old binding normally MissingBinding first. No automatic mutation retry or recreation. Durable issuer lookup is internal authenticated reconciliation only, not new H2 command.

lifecycle.event: authenticated durable material lookup succeeds after restart
lifecycle.result: May establish material transition only; cannot establish runtime install/Undo success or ACK. Fresh owner open and explicit new intent required; prior uncertainty remains recorded.
AppliedRetentionDeferred with original revisions, pin and mutation proof; never rollback, unchanged failure, automatic release or fabricated success.

h2_error_lifecycle.postcommit_stage: LiveRoots for install; UndoRoots for Undo outgoing retention; RedoRoots for retained redo root, according to actual failed root target. Multi-root failure reports first failed stage in declared order LiveRoots,UndoRoots,RedoRoots; retain all unresolved pins.
h2_error_lifecycle.uncertainty: UnverifiedOutcome does not assert zero changes. UI shows outcome unknown and requires reconciliation, preserves draft and disables blind retry. Other precommit failures assert zero content commit only when commit is positively known not attempted.

before.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
before.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
before.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
before.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. Exact bytes document fixtures required before RED.
before.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
before.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
before.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

after.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
after.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
after.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.

request_digest.algorithm: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 of ENTIRE validated request value, including body recursively. No field projection, ignored fields, defaults or post-hash enrichment. Authentication resolves every opaque handle before frozen body assembly. Server resolved identity/content/evidence fields shown in schema are mandatory.
canonicalization: Reject duplicates before object construction; unknown/missing/null outside declared union reject before replay lookup and IO.
Object names sorted by UTF8 bytes. All scalar text valid Unicode scalar values; no normalization.

Strings: quote and backslash escaped, backspace/tab/newline/formfeed/carriage-return as \b/\t/\n/\f/\r; remaining U+0000..001F as lowercase \u00xx; other scalars literal UTF8; no slash escaping/BOM/whitespace.
All integers U64Decimal strings checked in range. No numeric JSON tokens in transition hash schema.
Arrays preserve admitted order, including resolve requests, entries, aliases, roots, evidence and assets. Order changes conflict; do not sort/deduplicate after hashing.

Same key and valid changed body => ReplayConflict before IO; exact same bytes replay retained receipt. Invalid body => InvalidRequest before key lookup. SHA collision resistance assumed, not proved by vectors.
request_digest.excluded: Transport correlation, UI display strings outside declared operation, transient read handles and secrets are not request inputs. Any new behavior-affecting input requires schema/replan; cannot silently exclude.
request_digest.generated_outputs: Pin id created by pin/import is OUTPUT, never caller input. Existing pin_id mandatory for transfer/release. Selection handles freeze full native identity/raw digest/metadata before hash; bundle entries include all admitted metadata and alias mapping.
request_digest.read_only_calls: validate_pin/read_pinned_version/register_roots do not use transition receipt key; authorization and bounds still apply. Provider registration lifecycle unchanged.

after.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
after.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
after.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

after.interpretation: Each named FILE is schema root, never DTO prose subtree or ModuleSpec. Local refs resolve within file. No network resolution.

U64Decimal.semantic_validation: parse checked u64 <=18446744073709551615; reject JSON number; never JS Number conversion

before.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

U64Decimal.description: Checked runtime u64 <=18446744073709551615; no JSON number or JS Number

after.legacy_descriptors: Historical prose only; old blanket-converted Candidate/Select/Preview/Intent/common scalar descriptors superseded by exact named roots. No silent inferred schema.
